2006._notes: Segment EBIT from the fiscal-year 'EBIT - US$ Millions' table (USA Fibre Cement 342.6, Asia Pacific 41.7, R&D (15.7), Other (13.1), impairment of roofing plant (13.4), General Corporate (61.4), asbestos provision (715.6) = EBIT (434.9)). Adjusted NI = 'Net income excluding asbestos provision' 208.9 (supplemental information table). Net loss per share diluted (1.10); diluted shares = basic (461.7m) in a loss year. Volumes / average net sales price from the MD&A volume table (USA 2,182.8 mmsf at US$558/msf; Asia Pacific 368.3 mmsf at A$872/msf).

2007._notes: Net income 151.7 includes a 0.9 cumulative effect of a change in accounting principle (stock-based compensation); income before that effect 150.8. Income tax benefit 243.9 (asbestos-related deferred tax asset recognised on the Amended FFA). Adjusted NI = net operating profit 151.7 + asbestos adjustments 405.5 - tax benefit related to asbestos adjustments 335.0 = 222.2 ('Net operating profit excluding asbestos'). Segment EBIT: USA 362.4, Asia Pacific 39.4, R&D (17.1), Other (9.3), General Corporate (56.5), asbestos adjustments (405.5) = (86.6).

2008._notes: Segment EBIT (fiscal-year table): USA 313.6, Asia Pacific 50.3, Other (7.3), R&D (18.1), General Corporate (60.0), asset impairments (71.0), asbestos adjustments (240.1), AICF SG&A (4.0) = (36.6). Adjusted EBIT = 'EBIT excluding asbestos and asset impairments' 281.7 (asbestos 240.1 + AICF SG&A 4.0 + impairment charges 71.0 + impairment-related costs 3.2). Adjusted NI = net operating loss (71.6) + asbestos adjustments 240.1 - related tax benefit 45.8 + AICF SG&A 4.0 - AICF interest income 9.4 + impairment charges net of tax 44.6 + impairment-related costs net of tax 2.0 + tax adjustments 5.8 = 169.7 ('Net operating profit excluding asbestos, asset impairments and tax adjustments', Q4 FY08 Management's Analysis of Results, 6-K filed 23-May-2008). Net loss per share (0.16); diluted = basic 455.0m.
